variants.name: 01-cream
variants.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a premium portrait 9:16 background for Android app store screenshot cards for a gentle parent-facing child nighttime audio alarm app. This is a CLEAN BACKGROUND ONLY, no text, no lettering, no phone, no UI, no people, no logos. Keep upper 30 percent and central 70 percent of width very quiet, smooth and empty for future text and a large screenshot. Decoration only at outer edges and bottom corners, understated elegant and minimal. Warm yellow orange brand. Light warm ivory and cream background with faint honey golden light at bottom right and subtle soft translucent rounded layers along the bottom and outer edge. Very restrained, sophisticated editorial design, abundant negative space, almost imperceptible fine paper texture. Calm and readable.
